newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-GRIQUAS BEAT EASTERN TRANSVAAL 28-11.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-GRIQUAS BEAT EASTERN TRANSVAAL 28-11.

text.p: A spirited struggle from Eastern Transvaal was not enough to prevent a 28-11 defeat (halftime 8-8) by Griqualand West in their Currie Cup rugby fixture on Friday.
In their best performance this season the home side held Griquas in the first half but eventually succombed to the visitors' superior scrummaging and forward power.
Eastern Transvaal - Try: Jaco Viljoen. Penalties Viljoen (2).
Griqualand West - Tries: Ian Horn, Tobie de Jager, Abrie Pretorius. Conversions: Franco Smith (2). Penalties: Smith (3).
